scope: Carrier-first local geometry exploration, not full board acceptance or hardware qualification.

correctness_fix.defect: append_contract_group_faces invoked check_fanout on local instances without pad_nets. The check therefore had zero multi-pin subjects and could not reject starved candidates.
correctness_fix.repair: Populate every physical pad, including disconnected pads, with authored net names where available. This matches final-emission pin-count semantics. Prepare per-reference maps once for all candidate models.
correctness_fix.negative_control: Temporarily omitting production pin-map population made the new synthetic disconnected-pad test fail: fanout-starved disconnected-pad candidates were offered. Restored correction passes.

experiment.default: off; not exposed as a production CLI policy
experiment.candidate_policy: Reflect eligible contract-connected groups onto bottom, then optionally rotate each group independently through quarter turns. Stationary top parts remain fixed. Four alignments per orientation; preserve existing offer prefix, deduplicate, and apply local geometry, contract and non-vacuous fanout checks.
experiment.verification: Independent named-pad reflection/rotation oracle, stationary parts, authored pin-net identity, all three nonzero turns, reproducible geometry/order/receipts, instrumented scalar-operation counts, pinned owners, protruding copper and disconnected-pad fanout rejection.

tests.earlier_attempt: One concurrent source-audit run correctly rejected source modification during scanning. Final stable-source run passed. Initial test helper used dummy three-pin assignments; replaced them with actual footprint pads and authored connectivity before acceptance.

screen_diagnostics: All three constructed models pass placement-contract/flow diagnostics with zero hard RED. No new full qualification or renders.

smaller_outline_results.result: All reject at USB-JTAG interior seating. Two outer attempts each; captured failure receipts include executed orientation retry. No failed candidate accepted, fallback ceiling raised or constraint waived.

limits_and_next_step: No smaller board or speedup demonstrated. Timing samples overlapped targeted test work and are not a benchmark. Keep rotations opt-in and the qualified carrier incumbent. Additional rigid group orientations alone do not resolve the seating bottleneck; investigate global allocation of free space and sheet interactions rather than repeating these screens unchanged. Overall goal remains incomplete.
